author: Yara Mansour
text: The part about search intent finally made keyword research click for me. I rewrote two landing pages the same evening and both are ranking better already.

author: Tarek Hassan
text: Could you add a worked example for an e-commerce category page? The blog example was clear but product pages behave differently.

author: Lina Abdelrahman
text: Watched the Core Web Vitals lesson twice. The layout shift walkthrough alone was worth the whole course.

author: Khaled Fathy
text: Best explanation of closures I have seen. The drawing of the event loop is now a sticky note on my monitor.

author: Salma Gamal
text: Small note: the AbortController example throws on older Safari. Worth a warning in the lesson.

author: Mostafa Nabil
text: Container queries were the missing piece. I deleted about a hundred lines of breakpoints from our design system after week one.

author: Dina Sobhy
text: Thank you for leading with the profiler instead of memo. Half our slow renders turned out to be an unstable context value.

author: Ahmed Saeed
text: First course where I actually shipped something to the store. The publishing lesson is very underrated.
